title: The actual compact-support system evaluation diagram
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ and its positive quotient coefficients $A_{n+1}$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Work on small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] in the independent site and coefficient universes [def-weil-size-convention], with the actual completed coefficient sheaves $\widehat R_W$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. Let $j:X\hookrightarrow Z$ be an open immersion and $p:Z\to Y$ an arbitrary morphism [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Write $\mathscr S_W$ and $e_n$ for the ringed-sequence module category and its exact evaluations [def-coef-ringed-sequence-site]. Put $G=p_{*,\bullet}$ equal to the actual sectionwise direct image on quotient systems [def-trf-integral-comparison-sequence-systems]; put $G_n=p_{*,n}$ and $p_n^*$ equal to the actual module direct and inverse images at $A_{n+1}$ [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. The derived system and finite adjunctions are the descents of these ordinary adjunctions. For an open-operation presentation $o$ of [lem-sf-integral-open-reduction-comparison], use its concrete exact whole-system extension $J$ and restriction $P$, finite extensions $J_n$ and restrictions $P_n$, and the localization of its ordinary extension-evaluation isomorphism $Je_n\cong e_nJ_n$.

Define an evaluation presentation to consist of this open-operation presentation, additive/exactness and K-injective-resolution structures for the actual direct-image and inverse-image functors, the quotient scalar adjunctions $L_{W,m,n}\dashv\operatorname{Res}_{W,m,n}$ using the concrete derived quotient extensions of [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus], ordinary and derived comparison isomorphisms $\operatorname{Res}_{Z,m,n}G_m\cong G_n\operatorname{Res}_{Y,m,n}$, the four left and right adjoint evaluation isomorphisms for $J\dashv P$ and $p^*\dashv RG$, and ordinary isomorphisms $Ge_n\cong e_nG_n$. Here quotient comparisons and adjunction evaluation use the ordinary semilinear calculus [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections]; section, resolution, unit and counit normalizations are separate properties, not assumed in a presentation.

For such a presentation, define $S_n(M)=\operatorname{ev}_n(U_Y RG J M)$ and $T_n(M)=\operatorname{Res}_n RG_n J_n e_nM$. Define their comparison $\theta_n:S_n\cong T_n$ by the actual evaluation $\operatorname{ev}_n U_Y\cong\operatorname{Res}_n e_n$, followed by the supplied direct-image and open evaluations. For $n\le m$ define the source transition to be evaluation of the actual arrow $(m\to n)$ of the strict $\mathbf N^{\mathrm{op}}$ tower $U_Y RG J M$. Define $b_{m,n}:L_{Y,m,n}RG_m\to RG_nL_{Z,m,n}$ as the adjunction mate of the supplied derived restriction square. For $N=JM$, define $t^N_{m,n}$ as the adjunct of its actual $\tau^N_{m,n}$. Define the extension-form transition as $RG_n(t^N_{m,n})\circ b_{m,n,N_m}$. Define the target transition as $\operatorname{Res}_m$ of its transpose under $L_{Y,m,n}\dashv\operatorname{Res}_{Y,m,n}$, composed with the actual restriction-composition isomorphism $\operatorname{Res}_m\operatorname{Res}_{Y,m,n}\cong\operatorname{Res}_n$, and conjugated by the open evaluations at $m,n$ to have source $T_m(M)$ and target $T_n(M)$.

Also define normalization of a derived exact square. For additive $G:C\to A$, $G':C'\to A'$, exact additive $H:C\to C'$, $K:A\to A'$, ordinary $a:HG'\cong GK$, and derived $d:D(H)RG'\cong RG D(K)$, the predicate requires equality of the two resolution-comparison paths for every K-injective $J$ in $C$, K-injective $I$ in $C'$, and quasi-isomorphism $r:H(J)\to I$. With $Q$ the derived localization and $\rho_G(J):RG(QJ)\cong Q(GJ)$ the canonical K-injective comparison, the equation is
$$d_{QJ};D(K)(\rho_G(J));\operatorname{fac}_{K,GJ};Q(a_J^{-1});Q(G'r)=RG'(\operatorname{fac}_{H,J});RG'(Qr);\rho_{G'}(I).$$
This does not assume that $H$ preserves K-injectives. All data and arrows are concrete constructions, with no choice from an unproved mere existence theorem.

reviewed_lean.note: Read the item, the new def node, both modules, the report, prior returns and the IntegralOpenReduction/OpenSystems interfaces. Clauses, hypotheses, universes and edge cases match; the source and target transitions are real definitions, the functors are canonical, units/counits are conclusions; ordinary/derived coefficient squares, p evaluations and the j right evaluation are pinned by section/K-injective normalization and unit/counit equations; the scalar adjunctions cancel. Fault (H3): the existentially chosen open presentation o has unnormalized OpenSystems.restrictionEvaluation, so extensionEvaluation, theta and the target transitions can be twisted by per-level units (e.g. (-1)^n). Fix: the witness conjunct compactSupportOpenRestrictionSectionsNormalized (restrictionEvaluation is the identity on sections), which pins e_n J = j_! e_n; full replacement module and lean-record override with the declarations list; statement text unchanged; a rfl check of section-carrier defeq timed out (argued on paper). nt_compile --json clean: delivered 18.7 s/6.5 s, fixed 27.3 s/5.0 s.
